# 2 Baruch Chapter 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** "For those who live in this world, it is nothing but struggle and exhaustion. But the world to come is a crown — full of righteousness, honor, and glory for those who live there. That is why this world was designed to be temporary — it is only a crossing-point on the way to what is real."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. "Crossing-point" for "passage" — makes the transitional metaphor vivid. "What is real" added to imply the contrast between temporary and permanent, implicit in the Syriac.*
